hagiasophia.name: Hagia Sophia
hagiasophia.slogan: A dome that has outlasted empires since 537.
hagiasophia.line: Finished in 537, it stayed the largest cathedral in the world for nearly a thousand years.

bluemosque.name: Blue Mosque
bluemosque.slogan: Six minarets and a sky of blue tile.
bluemosque.line: Built 1609 to 1617, its interior is lined with 21,043 Iznik tiles in over fifty designs.

galatatower.name: Galata Tower
galatatower.slogan: The best seat for Istanbul's sunset.
galatatower.line: Built in 1348 as the Tower of the Holy Cross, it rises 62.59 metres above the Genoese quarter.

dolmabahce.name: Dolmabahçe Palace
dolmabahce.slogan: Gold and crystal on the Bosphorus shore.
dolmabahce.line: Its 285 rooms and 46 halls were gilded with 14 tonnes of gold leaf; the clock in Atatürk's room still shows 9:05.

maidenstower.name: Maiden's Tower
maidenstower.slogan: A tiny islet tower with a tall tale.
maidenstower.line: Legend says a princess was locked inside to escape a snake foretold to bite her; the first tower here dates to 1110.
